site_title.zh: 智慧技術導入能力成熟度評估

assessment_subtitle.en: Construction Safety Monitoring and Inspection Technologies
assessment_subtitle.zh: 施工安全監測與檢查技術

instructions_text.en: For each of the 22 indicators below, select the level (1–5) that best describes your organization's CURRENT state, and the level you believe the organization should TARGET. All 22 indicators need a current and a target level before you can submit.
instructions_text.zh: 請為以下 22 項指標，分別選擇最能描述貴組織「目前」現況的等級（1–5），以及您認為組織應「目標」達到的等級。送出前需完成全部 22 項指標的現況與目標等級。

instruction_what_text.en: This Digital Technology Adoption Maturity Assessment evaluates your organization's readiness to implement and use digital safety technologies in construction monitoring and inspection. It covers 22 key indicators across four domains: Strategy, Operational Readiness, People, and Technology.
instruction_what_text.zh: 這份評估用來評量貴公司採用智慧安全監測與檢查技術的準備程度，涵蓋 22 個子指標，分屬策略、執行流程、人力與技術四大類別。

instruction_rank_text.en: For each of the 22 indicators, select a level (1–5) for your organization's current state and the target level you believe it should reach:
instruction_rank_text.zh: 請為 22 個指標中的每一項，分別選擇最能描述貴公司現況的等級（1–5），以及期望達成的目標等級：

instruction_level_1.zh: 等級 1：初始（臨時、不可預測）

instruction_level_2.zh: 等級 2：可管理（具基本流程與控制）

instruction_level_3.en: Level 3: Repeated but locally inconsistent practice
instruction_level_3.zh: 等級 3：已定義（標準化、文件化）

instruction_level_4.zh: 等級 4：量化管理（可衡量與受控）

instruction_level_5.zh: 等級 5：持續優化（持續改善）

instruction_get_text.en: After completing all 22 indicators and submitting your assessment, you'll receive:
instruction_get_text.zh: 完成所有 22 個指標並送出評估後，您將獲得：

instruction_result_overall.en: Current and target overall maturity scores (1–5 scale)
instruction_result_overall.zh: 現況與目標整體成熟度分數（1–5 分）

instruction_result_category.en: Current and target domain scores (Strategy, Operational Readiness, People, Technology)
instruction_result_category.zh: 現況與目標各類別分數（策略、執行流程、人力、技術）

instruction_result_charts.zh: 視覺化圖表與成熟度分佈

instruction_result_pdf.zh: 可匯出的詳細評估報告（PDF）

instruction_meaning_title.zh: 這些結果應該如何解讀？

instruction_meaning_text.en: Your results show where your organization stands in adopting digital safety technologies. A higher score (closer to 5) indicates more mature processes, better documentation and measurement, and stronger continuous-improvement capability. Use the results to identify improvement areas and guide your digital transformation strategy.
instruction_meaning_text.zh: 您的結果顯示組織在採用數位化安全技術方面所處的成熟度。較高的分數（接近 5）代表流程更成熟、文件化更完善、量測更完整，並具有持續改進的能力。請利用這些結果來識別可提升的領域，並作為制定數位轉型策略的參考。

instruction_expected_time.en: Expected time: 15–20 minutes | All 22 questions require both current and target levels
instruction_expected_time.zh: 預計時間：15–20 分鐘｜全部 22 題均需完成現況與目標等級

id_assigned_note.en: This ID has been assigned to you for this session. You can close and reopen this page on this device to continue.
id_assigned_note.zh: 此編號已指派給您。您可以在此裝置上關閉並重新開啟此頁面以繼續作業。

assigning_id.zh: 正在指派您的專家編號…

no_id_available.en: All expert slots are currently full. Please check with the workshop host.
no_id_available.zh: 目前所有專家名額已滿，請與工作坊主持人確認。

please_complete_all.en: Please select a current and target level for all 22 indicators before submitting.
please_complete_all.zh: 送出前請完成全部 22 項指標的現況與目標等級選擇。

target_below_current.en: Target level can't be lower than the current level. Choose a level ≥ your current selection.
target_below_current.zh: 目標等級不能低於現況等級，請選擇大於或等於現況等級的選項。

current_above_target.en: Current level can't be higher than the target level. Choose a level ≤ your target selection.
current_above_target.zh: 現況等級不能高於目標等級，請選擇小於或等於目標等級的選項。

submitted_note.en: Submitted. You can keep editing your answers until the host locks the survey.
submitted_note.zh: 已送出。您可以持續編輯答案，直到主持人鎖定問卷為止。

survey_locked_message.en: The host has locked this survey. No further edits are possible.
survey_locked_message.zh: 主持人已鎖定此問卷，無法再進行編輯。

max_experts_label.en: Number of experts in this workshop

reset_all_confirm.en: This permanently deletes every expert's submission and progress, and unlocks/hides results. Continue?
reset_all_confirm.zh: 此操作將永久刪除所有專家的送出資料與進度，並解除鎖定、隱藏結果。確定繼續？

delete_expert_confirm.en: Remove this expert's data and free up their ID?
delete_expert_confirm.zh: 移除此專家的資料並釋放其編號？

lock_survey_label.zh: 鎖定問卷（停止進一步編輯）

revealed_status.en: Results are currently visible on the presentation page.
revealed_status.zh: 展示頁目前正顯示結果。

not_revealed_status.en: Presentation page is showing the submission counter only.
not_revealed_status.zh: 展示頁目前僅顯示送出人數。

live_averages_heading.zh: 即時各領域平均值（目前已送出）

presentation_title.zh: 智慧安全技術成熟度工作坊

waiting_subtext.en: Results will appear here once the host reveals them.
waiting_subtext.zh: 主持人顯示結果後，將於此頁呈現。

level_meaning_1.zh: 臨時且不可預測的流程。

level_meaning_2.zh: 具備基本控制的可重複流程。

level_meaning_3.zh: 標準化且文件化的流程。

pdf_report_title.en: Digital Safety Technology Maturity Assessment Report
pdf_report_title.zh: 智慧安全技術成熟度評估報告
